messages:
Zoe (CEO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: leadership wants a single-sentence partner-friendly status for API, Console, and Optimize plus the top blocker for each. Paste drafts here by EOD.

Mara (Product): API: limited preview next week; benefit line: stronger auth + SDK consistency. Top blocker: auth v2 rollout could impact long-lived connections.

Kevin L (Eng): Confirmed: 10% canary, ramp to 100% over 48h if stable. We'll watch connection resets and have rollback scripts ready.

Jess (Eng PM): Console: opt-in canary for route analytics and streamlined onboarding in June. Top blocker: telemetry v2 schema needs final sign-off. Sam, can you finish docs?

Sam (Docs): Yep — telemetry doc and examples will be PRd tomorrow morning. I'll make partner-friendly bullets too.

Alex (Optimize): Optimize preview: automated batching + cache hints to cut per-token costs. Top blocker: need an explicit opt-out in the UX for customers who don't want auto-suggestions. Filing ticket.

DevRel Bot: Created ticket OPS-9001 "opt-out control for optimize suggestions" assigned to Alex.

Riley (SRE): Infra note: auth toggle may cause brief routing resyncs; zero-downtime approach under validation but not guaranteed yet.

Ops (Release): Please tag release tickets with FINAL_SIGNOFF by Thu 17:00 UTC so we can lock windows.

Mara (Product): Draft partner-safe lines:
- API: "Limited preview: improved security and more consistent SDKs to simplify integrations."
- Console: "Opt-in preview: clearer route-level insights to help teams measure performance."
- Optimize: "Preview: suggested batching and cache recommendations to help lower inference costs."

Zoe (CEO): Nice. Keep it benefits-first. I'll send to partners after Sam confirms the partner copy. If canary fails, ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
